title: Deciphering Chemical Cues of Pinus halepensis Infestation by the Pine Processionary Moth: Phytochemical Analysis and Computational Insights into Essential Oil Component Interactions with Insect Odorant Binding Protein
authors: Safia Abla; Wafa Tachoua; Mustapha Mohamed Abou; Farid Chebrouk; Wafa TACHOUA
one_liner_zh: 该文分析松树精油成分与昆虫气味结合蛋白的分子对接和动力学模拟，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作建模，但对象为昆虫嗅觉蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Background The pine processionary moth, Thaumetopoea pityocampa, is a major defoliator of pine forests in the Mediterranean, notably affecting coniferous forests in Algeria. Insect odorant binding proteins (OBPs) play a crucial role in detecting pheromones and identifying host plants and oviposition sites. This study aimed to analyze the essential oils from both infested and healthy needles of Pinus halepensis and to investigate the role of GOBP2 in detecting plant volatiles through computational methods. Material and Methods Essential oils from infested and healthy Pinus halepensis needles were analyzed using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). The interaction between these volatiles and GOBP2 was explored through molecular docking using SwissDock, and the stability of the top-scoring docked complexes was evaluated with molecular dynamics simulations via the iMODS server. Results The analysis indicated an increase in monoterpenes and a decrease in sesquiterpenes and diterpenes in infested trees. Among the 44 volatiles with increased production, 16 compounds, including Methyl 7,13,15-abietatrienoate, Abietadiene, Palustral γ-Eudesmol, β-Copaene, Phenethyl 2-furoate, trans-Cadina-1(6),4-diene, α-Eudesmol, Phenyl ethyl 3-methyl-butanoate, Phenethyl 2-methylbutanoate, Lavandulyl acetate, β-Elemene, Linalool acetate, Cyclosativene, cis-Linalool oxide, and Linalool, showed favorable interactions with the hydrophobic cavity of BmorGOBP2. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that the complexes with Abietadiene and trans-Cadina-1(6),4-diene exhibited the highest stability. Conclusion The findings of this study provide valuable insights that could inform the development of pest management strategies targeting Thaumetopoea pityocampa.
abstract_zh: 背景 松异舟蛾（Thaumetopoea pityocampa）是地中海地区松林的主要食叶害虫，尤其对阿尔及利亚的针叶林造成显著影响。昆虫气味结合蛋白（OBPs）在检测信息素、识别寄主植物和产卵场所中发挥关键作用。本研究旨在分析健康和受侵染的阿勒颇松（Pinus halepensis）针叶中的精油，并通过计算方法探讨GOBP2在检测植物挥发物中的作用。材料与方法 采用气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析健康和受侵染阿勒颇松针叶的精油。利用SwissDock进行分子对接，探索这些挥发物与GOBP2之间的相互作用，并通过iMODS服务器进行分子动力学模拟，评估得分最高的对接复合物的稳定性。结果 分析显示，受侵染树木中单萜类化合物含量增加，而倍半萜类和二萜类化合物含量减少。在产量增加的44种挥发物中，16种化合物（包括Methyl 7,13,15-abietatrienoate、Abietadiene、Palustral γ-Eudesmol、β-Copaene、Phenethyl 2-furoate、trans-Cadina-1(6),4-diene、α-Eudesmol、Phenyl ethyl 3-methyl-butanoate、Phenethyl 2-methylbutanoate、Lavandulyl acetate、β-Elemene、Linalool acetate、Cyclosativene、cis-Linalool oxide和Linalool）与BmorGOBP2的疏水腔表现出良好的相互作用。分子动力学模拟显示，与Abietadiene和trans-Cadina-1(6),4-diene形成的复合物具有最高的稳定性。结论 本研究结果提供了有价值的见解，可为针对Thaumetopoea pityocampa的害虫管理策略开发提供参考。
